digest.component_or_area: verifier model selection across review kernel, plan review, completion, and code-review workflow gates
propositions: Three separate code paths for selecting the verifier model (review_kernel/verify.py, completion.py, code-review.yaml) each break off the default provider using implicit equality tests, causing non-default models to silently disable downgrade to the standard class.
The code-review.yaml verify step declares no model key and resolves to cfg.model (frontier), losing both the determinism of temperature: 0 and the cost benefit of downgrading to standard.

resolve_model does not resolve reserved class names (trivial/standard/frontier) through resolve_model_string, so adding model: standard to YAML passes the literal string instead of the resolved class id.
All three verifier paths must be unified to resolve the standard class consistently regardless of cfg.model or provider qualification, eliminating the equality-test selection logic.
Literal model ids (bare and provider-qualified) must pass through resolve_model_string and resolve_model unchanged to preserve backward compatibility with existing workflow YAML.
